examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A typed field with a calendar and a start time. Type the date, step a segment with the arrow keys, or use the calendar.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: Pass `value` and `onValueChange`. The value holds a `Date` and the times as `HH:mm:ss` strings, or empty strings until a time is chosen.

examples.title: Time only
examples.description: `variant="time-only"` shows only the time, chosen from scrolling hour, minute and AM/PM lists.

examples.title: Start and end time
examples.description: Leave `showEndTime` on (the default for date and time) to choose a start and an end time on one day.

examples.title: Seconds
examples.description: `showSeconds` adds a seconds list. It also turns on by itself when the value already carries seconds.

examples.title: Minute step
examples.description: `minuteStep` sets the spacing of the minute list, and `secondStep` does the same for seconds.

examples.title: Date limits
examples.description: `minDate` and `maxDate` dim the days outside the window, and typed dates outside it are ignored. `disablePastDates` is a shortcut for a `minDate` of today.

examples.title: Close on select
examples.description: `closeOnSelect` closes the picker as soon as a day is chosen, which suits date-only fields.

examples.title: Week start and locale
examples.description: `weekStartsOn={1}` starts the week on Monday. `locale` translates the calendar's month names, weekdays and day labels. The typed field stays day/month/year.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: `sm`, `default` and `lg` set the width of the field (280, 336 and 360px); the height is 44px for all three. The calendar panel is a compact 288px at most, whatever the field's width.

examples.title: Validation
examples.description: `error` shows a message under the field, turns the border red and sets `aria-invalid`. `required` adds an asterisk to the label.

examples.title: Form integration
examples.description: `name` adds a hidden input that submits the chosen date and time with the form.

examples.title: Keyboard
examples.description: The field is typed and stepped like a segmented input. Alt+ArrowDown, or Enter on the calendar button, moves focus into the calendar, which is one tab stop with arrow-key movement.

examples.title: Disabled and read only
examples.description: A disabled field cannot be focused. A read-only field can be focused and copied but not changed, and it does not open the calendar.
